convention: pixel and line measured from upper-left image outer corner; x/pixel increases right, y/line increases down; subpixel values denote converted display positions, not measurement precision. No +0.5 added to continuously digitized coordinates. QGIS .points uses negative image Y and disabled independent checks.
display_conversion: Crops originally viewed at width 1300: original_x = crop_left + displayed_x * crop_width/1300; original_y = crop_top + displayed_y * crop_height/display_height. Final point centers visually refined on 800x800 original-resolution annotated crops before fit. Modern coordinates: longitude=xmin+pixel/1200*(xmax-xmin); latitude=ymax-line/1200*(ymax-ymin), actual returned USGS EPSG:4326 extent.
manual_uncertainty: Order 10-30 original image pixels for broad features, not a surveyed accuracy estimate; mobile coastline introduces unknown additional error.
split: Four fitting points; two coastal checkpoints reserved before the first affine solve. No alternative transformation fitted and no errors consulted when selecting/refining positions.
rejected_candidates: Historical town centers: absent evidence of identical modern/historical settlement location.
Upper river confluences: reservoirs, generalized drainage and unresolved historical stream identities.
Pungo/Pamlico broad confluence: map outline and mouth definition ambiguous.
geometry: Coast-dominated fit; Eno-Haw and much of western extent outside fit-point convex hull; no interior independent checkpoints.
